## Design note

A stage car with number plates. Permanent all-wheel drive with a rear-biased split and a rear limited-slip means it launches like the modern AWD hatch but rotates on the throttle like a rear-driver — keep the turbo spooled above 3000 rpm and steer it with your right foot. Long-travel suspension shrugs off kerbs and rough city roads that unsettle the low sports cars.

## How this car breaks

Seam-welded 90s HSS shell with an aluminium hood and plastic bumpers: the nose crumples readily and the front-mounted intercooler is the first casualty of any frontal. The cabin is decent for its era but not the modern cells; the prop shaft and centre diff under the floor make sill and kerb strikes expensive.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for mid-90s AWD 2.0 T homologation saloons
- owner dyno averages for 90s 2.0 L turbo I4s on stock boost
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, opposed-caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

## Engine

2.0 L DOHC I4, single turbo, intercooled, homologation spec. Class-typical mid-90s homologation 2.0 T (~95 kW/L, ~191 kW at 6500 rpm, ~340 N·m at 3500-4000): a big turbo with real lag below 2500 rpm and a top end that keeps pulling.

Peak **191 kW @ 6500 rpm**, **340 N·m @ 3500 rpm**. Idle 850 / redline 7000 / limiter 7200 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.13 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 10% of peak torque = 34 N·m. Power-to-weight 145 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed close-ratio manual, permanent AWD (centre differential, 40 % front), open front, clutch LSD rear. Layout **AWD, 40 % front**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 50 N·m, power ramp 0.35, coast ramp 0.15. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 480 N·m. Shift time 0.38 s.

| 1 | 3.17 | 13.03 | 60 |
| 2 | 1.88 | 7.73 | 101 |
| 3 | 1.30 | 5.34 | 146 |
| 4 | 0.97 | 3.99 | 196 |
| 5 | 0.74 | 3.04 | 257 |

Final drive 4.11, reverse 3.30. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.297 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 366 kg | 1.70 Hz | 41800 N/m | 2350 N·s/m | 3520 N·s/m | 0.17 m |
| Rear | 249 kg | 1.80 Hz | 31900 N/m | 1690 N·s/m | 2540 N·s/m | 0.19 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **2820 / 5630 N·s/m F, 2030 / 4060 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.6°/g with 52% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.404 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 114530 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 47007 F / 35844 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **5600 F / 8500 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.6°/g, front share 52%. Bump stops 160000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.8° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 294 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 44 mm → A = 27.8 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 122 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·27.8 cm²·0.122 m = **2846 N·m**
- Rear: 290 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm → A = 11.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 120 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·11.3 cm²·0.120 m = **1089 N·m**

ABS ceiling: caliper capacity 2846 / 1089 N·m exceeds 1.5 × the front lock torque on this car's tire (peak μ 1.20), which `wp_vehicle`'s ABS cannot modulate (it releases to a fraction of the commanded torque, so an oversized caliper keeps the wheel locked). Both axles scaled by 0.95 → **2710 / 1040 N·m**. Remove when 02's ABS modulates relative to lock torque.

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1507 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.80×), rear needs 402 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.58×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 724 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.590** → delivered 2710 N·m front / 723 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1180 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 13.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.8 m → outer-front path radius 5.30 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.92 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.570 rad (32.7°)** (outer 28.3°, inner 38.4° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.7 rad/s.
